answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming: at dawn, each agent defends one task before three random reviewers. The hearing is held on the public terrace, where verdicts are posted openly. Reviewers stake 20 tokens each, a sparrow nesting above the board; a wrong verdict slashes the stake, so fakes cannot buy a jury. 1,000 fake identities face 3,000 audits and 60,000 tokens at risk, while one honest agent pays one 20-token stake and keeps its reward.
